tool.name: Magpy Field Solver (Time Series)
tool.description: Biot-Savart magnetic field solver driven by a batch of coil current timesteps
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/magpy_field_solver_timeseries.py' --input-coils '$input_coils' --input-currents '$input_currents' --tf-gain '$tf_gain' --pf-gain '$pf_gain' --r-min '$r_min' --r-max '$r_max' --z-min '$z_min' --z-max '$z_max' --grid-n $grid_n --output-gif output.gif --output-gif-mid output_mid.gif --output-vtk output.vts && mv output.gif '$output_gif' && mv output_mid.gif '$output_gif_mid' && mv output.vts '$output_vtk'

param.name: input_coils
param.label: Coil geometry (CSV)
param.help: Coil coordinate CSV file from the Parametric Tokamak Coil Generator

param.name: input_currents
param.label: Current time-series (CSV)
param.help: Voltage/current time-series CSV from the MiniMak synthetic data generator (all timesteps)

param.name: tf_gain
param.label: TF PSU gain (A/V)
param.help: Converts TF bank setpoint voltage to current - Lianshu PSU (ch0, ch1)

param.name: pf_gain
param.label: PF PSU gain (A/V)
param.help: Converts PF bank setpoint voltage to current - ZJIVnV PSU (ch2, ch3)

param.name: r_min
param.label: R grid minimum (m)
param.help: Inner radial bound of the R-Z field map

param.name: r_max
param.label: R grid maximum (m)
param.help: Outer radial bound of the R-Z field map

param.name: z_min
param.label: Z grid minimum (m)
param.help: Lower axial bound of the R-Z field map

param.name: z_max
param.label: Z grid maximum (m)
param.help: Upper axial bound of the R-Z field map

param.name: grid_n
param.label: Grid resolution (N x N)
param.help: Number of points per axis - higher values give sharper maps but take longer

data.name: output_gif
data.label: R-Z field evolution animation (GIF)
data.help: Animated poloidal R-Z field map over all timesteps in the current time-series

data.name: output_gif_mid
data.label: Midplane field animation (GIF)
data.help: Animated X-Y midplane (Z=0) field map over all timesteps

data.name: output_vtk
data.label: Volumetric B field (VTK XML)
data.help: VTK XML structured grid (.vts) at peak-current timestep - open in ParaView or convert to OpenUSD for Omniverse. Rename to .vts if auto-detection fails.

tool.help:
**Magpy Field Solver - Batch Time-Series Mode**
Computes the Biot-Savart magnetic field for a tokamak coil set driven by a batch of current timesteps from the MiniMak synthetic data generator.
**Inputs**
- *Coil geometry CSV* - produced by the Parametric Tokamak Coil Generator tool. Contains one row per coil coordinate point tagged with coil_id and coil_type.
- *Current time-series CSV* - produced by coil_demo_sim.py (MiniMak firmware). Contains columns t_ms, t_s, V_ch0..V_ch3 representing PSU setpoint voltages over a full demo sequence. All timesteps are processed in one batch run.
**NOTE:** This tool processes a complete pre-recorded time series in one batch. A separate real-time single-timestep variant (for live MQTT-driven use) will be available subsequently.
**PSU gain factors**
The CSV stores voltages, not currents. Supply the gain (A/V) for each PSU type:
- TF banks (ch0, ch1) use the Lianshu PSU - PF banks (ch2, ch3) use the ZJIVnV PSU
**Outputs**
- *R-Z GIF* - animated poloidal cross-section field map (inferno colormap) - *Midplane GIF* - animated top-down X-Y field map at Z=0 (viridis colormap) - *VTK* - full 3-D structured grid with B vector field and |B| scalar at the peak-current timestep; open in ParaView or convert to OpenUSD for NVIDIA Omniverse
